requirement_text: The system must allow users to select and follow their favorite teams and preferred sports channels in order to display personalized news and live results tailored to their selections. Users must be able to receive push notifications about news and results for their followed teams.
requirement_reference: "users can display current football news of their favorite teams and also select preferred sports channels individually." + "users have the option to personalize their experience by following favorite clubs and receiving notifications about news or results of their favorite teams."

user_story.user_story:
As a football fan, I want to follow my favorite teams and choose preferred sports channels so that I only see content and receive notifications that interest me.

Acceptance Criteria:
Given the app is installed and I am logged in,
When I select 'Arsenal' and 'Sky Sports' as my preferences,
Then only Arsenal news and results from Sky Sports are shown in my primary feed, and I am notified of new updates related to Arsenal.

requirement_text: The system must provide a live ticker module that retrieves and displays real-time updates and results for matches involving the user's favorite teams.
requirement_reference: "users can follow the results of their favorite teams live via a live ticker." + "option to retrieve the live results of their favorite teams in real time." + "integrated live ticker module that enables the retrieval and display of live data in real time."

user_story.user_story:
As a football fan, I want to see live updates for my favorite teams' matches so that I can follow the game in real time.

Acceptance Criteria:
Given I am following 'Arsenal' and a match is ongoing,
When I open the live ticker,
Then I see real-time updates for Arsenal's match, including goals, cards, and the latest score.

requirement_text: The system must allow users to view detailed information about any team and player, covering both national and international competitions.
requirement_reference: "Detailed team and player information will also be available at any time." + "extensive coverage of all leagues and competitions, both national and international."

user_story.user_story:
As a football fan, I want to look up detailed info about any team or player so that I can stay informed about football worldwide.

Acceptance Criteria:
Given I am on the team/player search page,
When I search for 'Lionel Messi' or 'Real Madrid',
Then I see comprehensive statistics, biographical details, and current performance data.

requirement_text: The system must display live stream links for matches from providers like DAZN or Sky Sport only when the broadcast has begun and transmission rights are fulfilled for the user's country.
requirement_reference: "integration of live stream links, for example, from providers such as DAZN or Sky Sport. These are available directly in the app as soon as the live broadcast has begun. Of course, it is ensured that compliance with transmission rights is maintained. Live streams will only be displayed when the respective rights are fulfilled in the country."

user_story.user_story:
As a football fan, I want to see links to live streams only when I am allowed to watch them, so that I am not frustrated by access issues.

Acceptance Criteria:
Given a live broadcast is available for my country,
When I open the match page during the live event,
Then I see a valid link to the stream provider (e.g., DAZN or Sky Sport).
Given the rights are not available for my country,
When I open the match page,
Then no live stream links are shown.

requirement_text: The system must allow users to share news articles and game reports directly to social media platforms from within the app.
requirement_reference: "users can share news and game reports via social media directly from the app."

user_story.user_story:
As a football fan, I want to be able to share exciting news and match reports with my friends via social media so that I can keep them updated.

Acceptance Criteria:
Given I am reading a news article,
When I tap the share button and select a social media platform,
Then the article is posted to my chosen social media account.

requirement_text: The system must provide an uncomplicated registration and login process that can be completed directly at app startup.
requirement_reference: "Registration and login are designed to be uncomplicated and can be completed directly at app startup."

user_story.user_story:
As a new user, I want to register and log in quickly at app launch so that I can start using the app without delay.

Acceptance Criteria:
Given I install and open the app for the first time,
When I proceed to register and/or log in,
Then the process completes within a few simple steps, and I am taken to the main dashboard.
